summary: Ionetix Corp filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of director David Landskowsky and the appointment of Michael Tarnok and CEO Kevin Cameron to the Board, increasing board size to five. The filing references a reverse triangular merger but provides no deal terms, price, or shareholder vote. The board actions are routine governance changes tied to an ongoing but unspecified Merger event. As no financial terms, premium, or definitive merger details are disclosed, this is classified as an other corporate governance update. Watch for a separate merger filing to surface deal mechanics.
